run_LucyEditPipeline: run the LucyEditPipeline to generate a video from a condition video and text prompt
encode_prompt: encode text prompts into T5 hidden state embeddings for the diffusion model
prepare_latents: prepare noisy and condition latents from input video frames for the denoising loop
check_inputs: validate pipeline inputs including video, prompt, dimensions, and guidance scale compatibility
summarize_LucyEditPipeline: summarize the LucyEditPipeline class for video-to-video generation with condition video appended to channel dimension
